# Larkfield Supply

> An invented outdoor kit shop. This site exists to test how AI crawlers and
> agents read an ordinary small shop, for Braille AI. Nothing is for sale.

## Gear
- [Fell 200 base layer](https://larkfield-supply.netlify.app/gear/base-layer): merino, 200gsm, £78
- [Glenmore rain shell](https://larkfield-supply.netlify.app/gear/rain-shell): three layers, taped, £245
- [Larkfield 45 pack](https://larkfield-supply.netlify.app/gear/pack): 45 litres, roll top, £160
- [Peat gaiters](https://larkfield-supply.netlify.app/gear/gaiters): knee height, £45
